The '''Antemeridian sector''' was in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] adjacent to [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]]. The sector capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was [[Antemeridias]].

==History==
{{Quote|The New Republic pressed its advantage and entered Moff Getelles's Antemeridian sector with two full ﬂeets. Getelles was powerless to stop them, and the sector (allong with a huge chunk of neighboring space) became New Republic territory.|[[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]|<ref name="TNEC" />}}
During [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rule, the sector was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tol Getelles|Getelles]]. After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Antemeridian sector became an independent sector ruled by the Moff Getelles. However Getelles stayed allied with the Empire and later [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon's]] [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="TNEC" />

In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], Getelles [[Battle of Nam Chorios|tried]] to take control of the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]], but was [[Invasion of the Antemeridian sector|defeated]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] before Admiral Pellaeon could intervene. The sector fell under New Republic control<ref name="TNEC" /> until it was invaded during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TEA" />

At the end of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], however, the sector was again in Imperial's hand and was governed by Moff Getelles, that was at that time a supporter of [[Jagged Fel]].<ref name="Apocalypse" />
